name: kss
description: Phase-based development workflow: clarify, investigate, grill, spec, plan, tickets, execute, review, docs — with a fresh thread between phases and token metrics

interface.shortDescription: Phase-based development, one phase per thread
interface.longDescription: KSS carries a software task from a vague request to a reviewed pull request, one phase at a time: clarify, investigate, grill, spec, plan, tickets, execute, review, docs. Context lives on disk rather than in the thread, every phase ends with a cost line and a fresh-thread point, and execution runs one subagent per ticket in its own git worktree. The same feature folder can be specified in one harness and executed in the other.
defaultPrompt: Use $kss-clarify to turn this request into a brief.
Use $kss-status to show where my features stand.
Use $kss-execute to run this feature's tickets.
